title: Uncertainty-Aware End-to-End AI Weather Forecasting: Disentangling Observation and Model Contributions
abstract: arXiv:2608.30795v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: End-to-end weather forecasting systems produce skillful global gridded and station forecasts directly from raw Earth observations, replacing the numerical weather prediction pipeline, including data assimilation, at a fraction of its cost. These systems are deterministic and issue no uncertainty. Here we render the Aardvark Weather model probabilistic by attaching one stochastic mechanism to each component: learned, input-dependent noise at the observation encoder, capturing aleatoric uncertainty inherited from the observing system, and Monte Carlo dropout in the processor, capturing epistemic uncertainty in the learned dynamics. The resulting nested ensemble attributes forecast spread to the two sources through a law-of-total-variance decomposition, cross-checked by withholding observation streams. translated_title: 不确定性感知的端到端AI天气预报：分离观测与模型贡献
translated_abstract: 端到端天气预报系统能够直接从原始地球观测数据生成高质量的全球格点和站点预报，以数值天气预报流程的一小部分成本取代了包括数据同化在内的传统数值预报流程。然而这些系统是确定性的，无法提供不确定性信息。本文通过为模型的每个组件附加一种随机机制，将Aardvark天气模型转变为概率模型：在观测编码器中引入可学习的、依赖于输入的噪声，以捕获源自观测系统的偶然不确定性；在处理器中使用蒙特卡洛dropout，以捕获所学动力学中的认知不确定性。由此产生的嵌套集合预报通过全方差定律分解，将预报离散度归因于这两个来源，并通过屏蔽观测数据流进行交叉验证。概率微调显著改善了平均预报效果，在所有变量和预报时效上平均提升4.2%。该集合预报是校准的……
tldr: 该论文通过在观测编码器加入依赖输入的噪声、在处理器中使用蒙特卡洛dropout，将确定性的Aardvark端到端AI天气预报模型概率化，利用全方差定律分解实现偶然不确定性与认知不确定性的分离归因，并通过概率微调使平均预报技巧提升4.2%。
en_tdlr: This paper makes the deterministic Aardvark end-to-end AI weather forecasting model probabilistic by attaching input-dependent noise to the observation encoder and Monte Carlo dropout to the processor, disentangling aleatoric and epistemic uncertainty via a law-of-total-variance decomposition, and improving mean forecast skill by 4.2% through probabilistic finetuning.
